system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The finalized agent configurations are then rendered in a structured JSON format, including each agent’s name, system prompt, and assigned tools.
system_prompt_style.note: A designer LLM writes each agent's system prompt. Paper only (arXiv:2507.22606); no repository evidence was provided.

env_context_strategy.note: Paper only; no instance template or config was available.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no history-processing code was available.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The output, which is a combination of LLM text
observation_format.note: Inferred from prose describing text plus tool responses.

tool_call_format.note: Paper only; no parser code was available.

tool_count.evidence_quote: We prepare the code interpreter and search engine in the tool pool for selection.
tool_count.note: This is the tool pool size. The designer assigns tools per agent, so the per-agent count may be smaller.

edit_primitive.note: Paper only; no edit tool was described.

tool_schema_source.note: Paper only; no tool schema code was available.

protocol_standardization.note: Paper only; no source or dependency list was available to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the verifier will guide the state transition to the appropriate
loop_primitives.note: The FSM runs with a condition verifier. On a null-transition the verifier feeds back to the agent and the agent refines its action. The FSM loop has no exact enum match.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: This FSM explicitly defines a set of states
planning_granularity.note: The designed FSM, with its states, instructions and transitions, acts as a structured plan.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: MetaAgent will first design agents needed to solve the task.
multi_agent_topology.note: An FSM over specialised agents with traceback. pipeline is the closest value; a transition graph with cycles does not fit exactly.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the agent’s output is saved as memory
delegation_mechanism.note: State transitions hand control to the next agent. The output is written to the listeners' memory.

human_in_loop.note: Paper only; no code was available to check for confirmation or approval hooks.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: each state represents a possible situation in the process of
short_term_state.note: The current FSM state plus per-agent listener memory.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Verifier checks if the agent’s output meets any of the
self_verification.note: The condition verifier is a separate LLM call. It uses the same system prompt as the task agent, so it could also be read as self_critique.

rollback.note: Paper only. State traceback is control flow, not a file rollback.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: indicating task completion, or until it exceeds the maximum
termination_condition.note: The run ends when a final state is reached, as decided by the verifier LLM, or when the maximum number of transitions is exceeded.

execution_isolation.note: Paper only; no deployment code was available.

eval_hooks.note: No repository was available to search.

target_domain.note: Evaluated on ML Bench, software development, creative writing and GPQA.

open_source.note: No LICENSE file was in the evidence. A code URL is given in the paper.

model_agnostic.note: The paper reports GPT-4o and GPT-3.5 results only; no client code was available.

primary_artifact.note: Only the paper was available as evidence. The other two papers in the bundle describe different systems with the same name and were ignored.
